# Contributing to ACT Build Controller

Thank you for taking the time to contribute. This project exists because of people
who believe that developer tooling should be local-first, private by design, and
community-governed.

---

## Before You Open a Pull Request

By submitting a Pull Request, you agree to the following:

1. **Contributor License Agreement (CLA):** You confirm that you have the right to
   contribute the code you are submitting, and you grant the project maintainer a
   perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free license to use your contribution under both
   the AGPLv3 and any future commercial licensing terms. This protects both you
   and the project — ensuring your contribution can never be used against you,
   and ensuring the project can remain sustainable.

2. **Code of Conduct:** Contributions are expected to be respectful, constructive,
   and in good faith.

---

## CLA Assistant

This repository uses **[CLA Assistant](https://cla-assistant.io/)** to automate
the CLA signing process. On your first pull request, a bot will prompt you to
sign with a single comment. It takes under 30 seconds.

---

## How to Contribute

- Open an Issue before large changes to discuss the approach.
- Keep PRs focused and single-concern.
- Ensure your code passes `npm run lint` before submitting.
